summary: Join our specialized training on health insurance schemes in social protection systems. Equip yourself with essential tools for impactful policy development.
lede: Health insurance schemes in social protection systems organize financing to support healthcare access and financial protection. For professionals who shape, fund, or manage health and social protection programs, the course offers practical tools to design coverage and benefit packages, pool financial risks, and evaluate equity and financial sustainability.
audienceIntro: This training is ideal for professionals who plan, fund, or manage health and social protection programs, including:
audience: Policymakers in Ministries of Health, Finance
Health insurance fund managers and administrators
Social security and pension scheme officers
Donor and development partner program leads
NGO and civil society organization (CSO) staff
Consultants in UHC and health systems
modules: Foundations of Social Protection and Health Insurance
Integrating Health Insurance into Social Protection Systems
Health Insurance in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
Policy Analysis and Advocacy for UHC
